Wukong bundled wireless ADB components

LibADB Android 3.1.1 with Wukong local patches
Copyright 2021 Muntashir Al-Islam.
https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/libadb-android/tree/3.1.1
Local stream-open race, timeout and pairing-log fixes are documented in
third_party/libadb/README.wukong.md; patched sources are included in that directory.
Used under its Apache-2.0 option; additional upstream file notices apply.

SPAKE2 Android 2.2.1
https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/spake2-java/tree/2.2.1
LGPL-3.0. Full corresponding source, including the native submodule and Wukong 16 KB build configuration, is included in spake2-2.2.1-source.zip.
See spake2-LGPL-3.0.txt, GPL-3.0.txt and the source archive's file notices.
This library may be modified and relinked. Reverse engineering to debug modifications
to this library is not restricted by Wukong. Rebuild instructions are in
docs/third-party.md in the Wukong source project.

Conscrypt Android 2.9.0
https://github.com/google/conscrypt/tree/2.9.0
Apache-2.0 and bundled upstream notices; see conscrypt-LICENSE.txt.

Bouncy Castle 1.81
https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/tree/r1rv81
MIT-style license; see bouncycastle-LICENSE.html.

These are libraries compiled or packaged inside Wukong, not separately installed apps.

PaddleOCR Android SDK and PP-OCRv6_tiny_det / PP-OCRv6_tiny_rec ONNX models
Copyright PaddlePaddle Authors. Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/tree/dab3fe35379033fdcb2d0e9572fac0b36c9a9ebf
https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_tiny_det
https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_tiny_rec
See paddleocr-Apache-2.0.txt. Model files and dictionaries are bundled locally.

ONNX Runtime Android 1.21.1
Copyright Microsoft Corporation. MIT; see onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt and
onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt for bundled dependency notices.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.21.1

OpenCV Android 4.14.0
Apache-2.0; see opencv-LICENSE.txt and opencv-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/tree/4.14.0
